from tool import search_flights, filter_flights, search_hotels, filter_hotels, search_attractions, filter_attractions, search_nearest, sort_results, get_results_from_cache, save_to_cache

# Search for flights from Tucson to San Jose on May 14, 2025 (first leg)
search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Tucson",
    end_airport_city="San Jose",
    departure_date=["May 14, 2025"],
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Search for flights from San Jose to Tucson on May 20, 2025 (return leg)
search_flights(
    start_airport_city="San Jose",
    end_airport_city="Tucson",
    departure_date=["May 20, 2025"],
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Filter departure flights for first class (using cached results)
prior_departure = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights")
filtered_departure = filter_flights(
    prior_results=prior_departure,
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Filter return flights for first class (using cached results)
prior_return = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_return_flights")
filtered_return = filter_flights(
    prior_results=prior_return,
    flight_class=["first"]
)

# Save filtered flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights", value=filtered_departure)
save_to_cache(key="filtered_return_flights", value=filtered_return)

# Search for 2-star hotels in Downtown San Jose with business facilities and gym
search_hotels(
    city="San Jose",
    neighborhood=["Downtown San Jose"],
    stars=[2],
    gym_present=True,
    has_business_center=True
)

# Filter hotels for business facilities and gym (using cached results)
prior_hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=prior_hotels,
    gym_present=True,
    has_business_center=True
)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for historical attractions in San Jose
search_attractions(
    city="San Jose",
    type=["Historical"]
)

# Filter attractions for historical type (using cached results)
prior_attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")
filtered_attractions = filter_attractions(
    prior_results=prior_attractions,
    type=["Historical"]
)

# Save filtered attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_attractions", value=filtered_attractions)

print("No planning needed")
